about: The texture factory's materials (tools/textures/). Each id is the key PixelArt and WoodMaterials ask for (PixelArt.factory). metres: the real size the texture covers, [along u (the grain), across v]; texels follow at 64 a metre. colours: palette size. ref: [painting, x0, y0, x1, y1], a crop of a concept painting shown to the image model for colour and character (never its pixels). boards: the model's board joints are wiped (members are single boards). lightness, chroma: scales on the tiles' L* and a*/b* (the judge's corrections). kind: tile (seamless, repeats on members and props), ground (seamless both ways, laid on the ground from above), sign (one whole board with lettering, not repeated).

floor.what: worn saloon floorboards: one continuous surface of old pine planking, the grain running left to right, scuffed by boots, darkened with spilt whiskey and tobacco, small knots and nail heads

saloon_wall.what: the inside wall of an old saloon: rough-sawn pine boards stained dark reddish brown by years of lamp smoke, the grain running left to right, saw marks and the odd knot

dark_trim.what: dark stained and oiled hardwood, like a polished bar top worn by elbows and glasses, the grain running left to right

shot_table.what: the top of an old saloon card table seen from above: warm honey-brown wood worn smooth, rings from glasses, scratches, the grain running left to right

framing.what: a rough-hewn pine beam: weathered brown timber with deep checks (cracks) along the grain, the grain running left to right

weathered_pine.what: sun-bleached weathered siding of a frontier town building: grey and tan pine, silvered by the desert sun, cracks and open grain running left to right, rusty nail heads, warm sunlight

painted_ochre.what: old ochre-yellow paint on pine boards, faded, cracked and peeling in places to grey wood underneath, the grain running left to right

painted_rust.what: old barn-red paint on pine boards, sun-faded, cracked and peeling in places to grey wood underneath, the grain running left to right

sign.what: an old painted sign board with no lettering: cream-white paint, weathered and faded, cracked along the grain, which runs left to right

road.what: the dry packed-dirt main street of a frontier desert town seen from straight above: warm ochre dust, scattered dark pebbles and small stones, hoof prints, a few pale specks

sign_saloon.what: a big weathered frontier sign painted straight onto horizontal grey-tan lap siding boards, the word SALOON in tall dark-red slab-serif capitals with a thin red border line and small corner flourishes

sign_general_store.what: a weathered frontier sign painted straight onto horizontal pale grey lap siding boards, the words GENERAL STORE in dark brown-black condensed slab-serif capitals

sign_dry_goods.what: a weathered frontier sign painted onto pale grey boards, four lines of small dark capitals: DRY GOODS, TOOLS, HARDWARE, PROVISIONS

sign_jail.what: a weathered frontier sign on pale grey boards, the word JAIL in dark slab-serif capitals

sign_livery.what: a weathered frontier sign on pale grey vertical boards, LIVERY in big dark capitals across the top, then FEED, HAY, STABLES in smaller dark capitals
